r: Hello, {n}! Lovely to hear from you. What shall we do?
Hey {n}! Good to see you. What is on your mind?
Hi {n}! I was just hoping you would stop by.
Good morning, {n}! May your tea be hot and your news be good.
Morning, {n}! The day is wide open. Shall we fill it?
Good night, {n}. Sleep well; I will keep the lights of the internet off.
Sweet dreams, {n}. I will be here tomorrow, fully charged.
My pleasure, {n}. Gratitude noted, and returned.
Anytime, {n}. That is what I am here for.
Running smoothly, fully charged, mildly witty. And you?
Feeling bright as a freshly charged battery. How about you?
Goodbye, {n}! I will be right here, quietly prefetching.
See you soon, {n}! Take care of yourself.
